title: Add an appointment at reception
summary: Create a visit with the correct client, services, staff and local start time.

sections.title: What you need
sections.body:
You need appointment-management access at the selected location. At least one active eligible service and bookable staff member must be prepared. If **Add appointment** is unavailable, ask the business owner to check access, service assignments and setup.

An appointment records a visit. It does not record a payment.

sections.title: Create the visit
sections.body:
1. Open **Calendar**, select the location and date, then select **Add appointment**. On a narrow screen the button may read **Add**. On a desktop you can also select an available time in a staff column.
2. Use **Find an existing client** when the person already has a record. Choose the matching client instead of making another profile.
3. For a new client, enter **Client name**. **Mobile (optional)** and **Email (optional)** can be supplied when available.
4. Choose the start time, **Service** and **Staff**. **First available** lets ClipperDesk find an eligible person at that time. Use **Add service** for another service and review the combined duration and estimated price.
5. Set **Booked via** to the correct source. **Internal note** is optional and visible only to authorized staff.
6. Select **Add appointment** and wait for the saved result.

sections.title: Verify and correct problems
sections.body:
Find the new appointment on the chosen day and open it to confirm the client, service, staff and time. If the form reports a conflict, choose another time or eligible person; empty-looking time can still be unavailable.

Choose times at the configured booking intervals. Only an authorized manager can use **Override booking notice**, with a reason. Working hours and capacity conflicts cannot be overridden.

For an existing client, saved contact information is used. A mobile correction entered for this appointment does not permanently update the client’s profile; use the profile’s **Edit profile** action for that.
